gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-hoover: Stencil-cut and tall. Snowburst One splits its letters with wide bridges, while Hoover, a text serif, gives a generous e and short ascenders.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-trench-slab: Trench Slab sits close to the baseline, its capitals barely taller than its lowercase, and it carries a dignified weight. Snowburst One brings the stencil swagger above it, and the two feel like a loud voice beside a refined one.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-domine: Dignified Domine keeps its ascenders compact and gives every curve breathing space, a classic serif with only a slight pinch at the stems. Snowburst One is best at stencil flair; Domine is best at quiet text.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-esteban: Snowburst One cuts its tall lowercase from a stencil sheet, with low contrast and wide bridges between letters. And Esteban, a classic serif with moderate contrast, gives that bold heading a refined, wide-open e to land on.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-faustina: Snowburst One is stencil-cut and expressive, with tall lowercase and low contrast, nothing like the classic serif Faustina beneath it. Give it big, short words.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-halant: Halant reads authoritative and traditional, a text serif with a faint thick-thin shift and a towering x-height. Snowburst One earns its keep when it runs big and short.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-headland-one: Dignified Headland One spaces its letters well apart and varies its strokes gently, like a lightly tilted nib. But Snowburst One brings the stencil bridges and bold personality that the pairing's strongest contrast comes from.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-hedvig-letters-s: Bold stencil cuts meet quiet restraint here. Snowburst One does its best with low-contrast display shapes, but Hedvig Letters Serif, a classic serif with open curves and medium-key contrast, does its best at steady text.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-lisu-bosa: Snowburst One is a stencil sheet with wide bridges and an opening like a sprung paper clip, tall in the lowercase. But Lisu Bosa, a serif with understated contrast and spilling counters, would carry a long passage with sturdy, editorial ease.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-marcellus-sc: Snowburst One is expressive and stencil-built, with wide bridges and tall lowercase, while Marcellus SC adds a text serif with mild thicks and pulled-back terminals. Boldness and literary dignity share the page.
